_readme: Who Exiled is. Two lists, because they are different identities.
names        League accounts, including the RU server. The active player
normally resolves from the Live Client API, which is
reliable; this list is the fallback for EVENT names, whose
format differs and which have already been seen non-Latin
('Your creatures on team болтяра died'). When _is_me fails
there his own kills and deaths route as ALLY events, and she
talks about him in the third person while reacting to
chat_names   Twitch login, and whatever the voice source resolves to.
THIS is the list that decides she is talking to HIM rather
than to a viewer: it selects the CHAT_EXILED framing, gives
his message OWNER_PRIORITY, and stops it being dropped when
a viewer's message scores higher in the same batch.
Matching ignores case, spaces and punctuation, and a '#TAG' suffix is
optional — both 'Exiled Rain' and 'Exiled Rain#EUW' match. Add freely; an
unused name costs nothing, a missing one costs a whole stream.
